user.title: Xiaomi Live Map
user.description: Pick the robot. The map is read through the Xiaomi cloud session of Xiaomi Cloud Map Extractor. The entities are optional and make the map faster and smarter.

data_description.vacuum_entity: Polls fast while it is cleaning, returning or paused, and reacts the moment a clean starts.
data_description.active_entity: Optional on/off entity that is on for the whole job, including mop-washing breaks at the dock.
data_description.map_name_entity: Optional sensor holding the live map object name (JSON with an obj_name ending in the map name). Without it the map named 0 is read, which is right for most robots.

error.unknown_source: That map extractor entry no longer exists.
error.unsupported_model: Only Xiaomi-platform robots (models starting with xiaomi.vacuum.) are supported.

abort.no_source: Set up Xiaomi Cloud Map Extractor (v3) for your robot first.
abort.already_configured: Every robot from Xiaomi Cloud Map Extractor already has a live map.

data.watch_interval: Update interval while cleaning, card open
data.active_interval: Update interval while cleaning, no card open
data.idle_interval: Update interval while docked, no card open

data_description.watch_interval: The robot uploads its map every few seconds while it cleans. Each update is one small cloud download.
data_description.idle_interval: While a card is open and the robot is docked, the map is checked every 30 seconds.
